newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bund bulls hold sway, aim for 102.46.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bund bulls hold sway, aim for 102.46.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will remain bullish on Tuesday and should break through Monday's high at 102.32 to target 102.46, technical analysts said.

"There's a generally supportive background to Bunds at the moment," said David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London. "We should try to get through yesterday's high which takes us to 102.46 at least."
Charts show the June contract hit a daily high of 102.46 on March 5.
By 0656 GMT, June Bunds were down five basis ponts at 102.22, off their 102.20 opening level.

Above 102.46, Wood said the market would aim for 102.79. "That's the next logical target -- there's a bit of resistance there on daily charts and it's an old high," he said. Charts show the market hit a daily high of 102.79 on March 4.
Wood was unconcerned by the lower opening in the Bund. "I don't think that's a problem," he said.
"Hopefully you'd be long at the moment...then hope that we rally towards 102.46 and try and sell up there. It's not a good market to sell right now."
Wood put immediate support for the contract around 102.18,08.
Analysts at one European bank said a close back under 101.00 for the June contract would be negative for the market.
"But we still look for 102.50/60 to be reached before the chance of better selling pressure emerging," they said.

By 0714 GMT the September Euromark contract was unchanged at 96.76. Analysts at the European bank said there was scope for a push to the low 96.80s area. "First support lies in the low 96.70s," they said.
